summary: Preserve bilingual exhibition/venue identity and conservative schedule/admission semantics through bounded read-only source discovery.
reason: The website feed silently ignores some Contentful operators; verified single-key sorts and capped local artist/distance filtering prevent unrelated results and false opening or ticket claims. MCP must expose the same bounded discovery tree and exclude raw transport/unused mirror registrations.
validated_outcome: Deterministic date/archive, cache, throttle, closure and partial-join tests plus read-only live filters.
